noticias.titular: Judge says he intends to be available for Wild Card series
noticias.texto: Yankees' slugger Aaron Judge told ESPN on Wednesday that he intends to be ready for Game 1 of the Wild Card series at Yankee Stadium next Tuesday.

noticias.titular: Braves activate set-up man Suarez, target 2 appearances ahead of playoffs
noticias.texto: Braves reliever Robert Suarez, who has been sidelined more than three months with right elbow inflammation, was activated with the aim of being used Wednesday night and again Saturday ahead of the postseason.

noticias.titular: Blue Jays' Max Scherzer: Announcement on future coming
noticias.texto: Max Scherzer said after Wednesday's game that he'll likely have something to say in the next couple days about his future.

noticias.titular: Nats' Cade Cavalli gets $4M lockout-shielded signing bonus
noticias.texto: Nationals pitcher Cade Cavalli will get a $4 million signing bonus as part of his new deal which will be shielded from losses from a possible lockout.

noticias.titular: Zack Wheeler fans 7 straight to open Phillies win over Brewers
noticias.texto: Zack Wheeler struck out 11, including seven in a row to start the game, and Bryson Stott hit a tiebreaking single with two outs in the eighth inning as the Phillies inched closer to clinching a playoff spot with a 6-4 victory over the Brewers.

noticias.titular: Rockies hit latest low, become fifth team with 4 straight 100-loss seasons
noticias.texto: The Rockies became just the fifth club in MLB history to lose at least 100 games in four straight seasons and the first to do so since th Mets from 1962 through 1965.

noticias.titular: Drew Rasmussen shuts down Yankees to help Rays clinch AL East
noticias.texto: Drew Rasmussen took a no-hit bid into the seventh inning as the Rays beat the Yankees 6-1 on Tuesday to clinch their fifth AL East title.
